reference: Olkiluoto, Finland, crystalline bedrock (no published log for these boxes)

description.lithology: Migmatitic biotite gneiss, medium to light grey, medium-grained, foliated to nebulitic with irregular quartz-feldspar leucosome patches and streaks in darker biotite-rich palaeosome

anomalies.explanation: A sharp diagonal fracture cuts the core about two-thirds along the run at the red orientation mark and should be checked.
